title: Automatic incident detection + 24 h review buffer on every device
description:
Monitoring runs on its own: no test to write, no script to run, and every device keeps a 24 h review buffer.

A set-top box froze in the evening. Nobody was watching. The heatmap keeps one frame a minute from every device; scrub back to the minute, click the red tile, and the device's own recording replays its last 24 hours: stuck on a channel banner for four and a half minutes, then back on air. The freeze was detected and logged as an incident on its own, with the frames it compared and why it called it a freeze.
